segments.name: Electronic Components
segments.description: Distributes electronic components and provides design, supply chain, and embedded solutions to high and medium-volume customers across industrial, automotive, defense and aerospace markets.
segments.evidence: Avnet's EC reportable segment primarily supports high and medium-volume customers. It markets, sells, and distributes electronic components from many of the world's leading electronic component manufacturers, including semiconductors, IP&E components (interconnect, passive and electromechanical components), and other integrated and embedded components.

segments.name: Farnell
segments.description: Distributes electronic components, kits, tools, and test products to lower-volume customers and engineers primarily through e-commerce channels for development, prototyping and testing.
segments.evidence: Avnet's Farnell reportable segment primarily supports lower-volume customers that need electronic components quickly to develop, prototype, and test their products. It distributes a comprehensive portfolio of kits, tools, electronic components, industrial automation components, and test and measurement products to both engineers and entrepreneurs, primarily through an e-commerce channel.

revenueModel.text: Avnet generates revenue by distributing electronic components and related products to OEMs, EMS providers, ODMs, engineers and entrepreneurs, earning margins on sales.
revenueModel.evidence: Avnet, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries (collectively, the "Company" or "Avnet"), is a leading global electronic component technology distributor and solutions provider that has served customers' evolving needs for more than a century.
